note: Root-level registry: one entry per module. Item-level work lives in docs/modules/<module>/feature_list.json. A module is 'done' only when every item in its module registry is 'done'.

features.name: Platform foundation
features.description: Repair the broken baseline left by the lending-app strip, swap the design system to the SafePermit palette/typography, build the app shell (dark sidebar + topbar, responsive drawer), wire i18n (en/th), contractor auth + route guard, the API client with backend error-code localization, and notification polling.

features.name: Permit core
features.description: Permit models/enums/safety-range constants, the permit provider, My Permits list, the 6-step New Permit wizard, Permit Detail (status banners, QR, audit timeline), the closure checklist modal with its blocked states, and the Fire Watch countdown.

features.name: History
features.description: Searchable, filterable, paginated permit history with CSV export and drill-in to permit detail. Reuses the permit provider from feat-002.

features.name: Certificates
features.description: Personnel certificate provider/models, certificate list with valid/expiring-soon/expired badges, add-certificate form, and the certificate gate that blocks permit submission for workers with a missing or expired cert.

features.name: Real API integration
features.description: Re-align the API layer to the real Elysia backend BEFORE the wizard is built on it: /api/v1 prefix, camelCase both ways (humps deleted), cookie-session auth, the { code, message, errorCode } error body and its 21-code vocabulary, permit/certificate shapes off the stubs, and a live smoke check. Ground truth is docs/api/openapi.json with docs/main/dev-handoff/04-api-contract.md as its prose. Harness: docs/modules/api-integration/
features.evidence: 2026-08-17: all 10 API-* items done. ./init.sh green — typecheck PASS, lint PASS, vitest 26 files / 309 tests PASS, live smoke 16/16 PASS against a running backend. The baseline was RED before this module (a drifting stub fixture, documented in API-001) and is now green. Both *.mock.ts files and every USE_STUB_DATA flag are gone; the app talks to the real API. See docs/modules/api-integration/ and docs/api/GAPS.md.

features.name: Manual E2E Test Pass
features.description: Human-executed end-to-end testing of every contractor screen against a real backend. Suites in docs/testing/suites/, dated results in docs/testing/runs/, master plan in ../../docs/e2e/E2E-TEST-PLAN.md. Blocked in full on E2E-000 — no contractor account exists, so the app cannot currently be logged into. Harness: docs/modules/e2e-manual/
features.evidence: Plan and harness written 2026-08-19, awaiting review. Nothing executed.
